tools.name: lookup_fax_number
tools.description: Find the fax number for a US state or federal agency, with the official source it was read from and when it was last verified. Covers Social Security field offices across 56 states and territories (search by city or state), MassHealth, California EDD, Illinois IDES, NJ FamilyCare, IRS Form 2553, FEM

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Start a fax to a US fax number. Opens a form in this chat where the user adds pages from their phone camera or a PDF, adds an optional cover page, and pays.
